rationale: Builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline but spends the fp16 export budget differently: recurrent tail blocks now preserve K/V instead of Q/K, and the exit block keeps Q/V. The local signal says recurrent-tail float rescue is still live, while anchor and curriculum variants have flattened. This is a compact export-path change aimed directly at final int8+zlib roundtrip fidelity rather than training-loss behavior, and it stays well under the 1500-line limit.
title: Recurrent Tail KV/V Export Reallocation
